claims.quote: FS results from mutations in a single allele of the FOXG1 gene, leading to impaired FOXG1 function.

claims.object_text: Foxg1 heterozygous (HET) mice with a null allele
claims.quote: We analyzed HET mice with a null mutation allele in a single copy of Foxg1, and found that they show various phenotypes resembling the symptoms of the human FS individuals.

claims.object_text: increased anxiety in the open field
claims.quote: increased anxiety in the open field
impairment in object recognition, motor coordination

claims.object_text: impairment in fear learning and contextual and cued fear memory
claims.quote: impairment in object recognition, motor coordination, and fear learning and contextual and cued fear memory

claims.object_text: Foxg1 HET mice recapitulate some human FS symptoms
claims.quote: Our results suggest that Foxg1 HET mice recapitulate at least some symptoms of the human FS individuals.
